Fiction/Nonfiction? Scary, sci fi, fantasy, romance? Classic literature or modern/recent? You will get random recommendations without some kind of filter of what you are interested in.

If you haven't read Dune (by Frank Herbert) yet I definitely recommend reading it. It sometimes gets shoved into the whole category of SciFi (because it's set in the future/space/etc.) but it's really so much more than that. It has mystery, politics, interesting religious themes, etc. It is truly a classic that has it all.

I've read all of the Dune books and if you can make it through them I think you'll find it worth it. I say "make it through" because a couple of them are pretty hard reads. A lot of people will read the first that I just linked and then go to the 2nd and think "what the hell is this?". Some people will make it to the 3rd and think "OMG, I love it!" (the 3rd is widely regarded as being the 2nd best of the series) and then go on to 4th and think "great... more crap".

Either way at least read the 1st one.
